Date: 2027-08-19T09:24:00-07:00
Subject: Bespoke residency & audit window options — Cardea Pilot

Hi Sanjay,

Thanks again for the chat this morning. Per our discussion, here's a concise summary of the private hosting option we can offer for the Cardea pilot and the items that will need alignment before legal signs:

- Hosting: Private VPC deployment in eu-west-1 (data residency guaranteed to region).
- Audit access: standard is annual third-party audit (SOC2). Cardea asked about a tighter live-access window for on-site or remote audits — we can support a timeboxed window with pre-notice.
- Key management: we support customer-managed KMS keys; HSM integration available but requires additional ops work and a short onboarding SLA.
- Term & pricing: 12-month initial commitment; preliminary quote attached (pricing-summary-quote.pdf).

I've attached a draft mutual action plan and our SLA for your review. If Cardea needs a guaranteed audit window or reduced notice, share specifics (how many days, who needs access) and I can escalate for a bespoke carveout.

If you want to lock pricing for a longer commit (24–36 months) we can talk about a term credit. Happy to jump on another call — propose Tue 8/24 10am PT if that works.

Cheers,
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
+1 (415) 555-0124

Attachments: Cardea_MutualActionPlan.xlsx (spreadsheet), Redwood_SLA-draft.pdf (pdf)
From: Sanjay Mehta <sanjay@cardea.health>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@cardea.health; legal@cardea.health
Date: 2027-08-20T10:11:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Bespoke residency & audit window options — Cardea Pilot

Diego — thanks for the summary. A few asks from our side before we move to legal redlines:

1) Audit cadence: for our regulators we'd prefer two short remote audit windows per year (up to 2 business days each) with 10 business days notice. Is that something Redwood can commit to?
2) KMS/HSM: we require HSM-backed keys for key material at-rest. If HSM is not feasible, we need a written exception listing operational differences.
3) Pricing: Cardea is evaluating a 3-year pilot (with volume ramp), and we'd need a 40% time-limited discount to commit to a multi-year ARR ramp and an upfront partial prepay.

If you can confirm what you can accept (audit windows, HSM support, discount envelope), we'll circulate a LoI internally.

Regards,
Sanjay Mehta
Head of Platform Engineering, Cardea Health
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>

Subject: Fwd: Cardea asks — need exec approval on carveouts & discount

Team — forwarding Cardea's asks below. TL;DR: customer requests biannual 2-day audit windows (10 business days notice), HSM-backed keys, and a 40% discount for a 36-month ramp with partial upfront payment.

My read / recommended approach:
- Audit windows: operationally reasonable if we limit to remote access and require a pre-approved scope (no ad-hoc access to raw host). Recommend granting two remote windows/year of up to 2 business days each, with detailed scope and a Red-team-aware schedule.
- HSM: we can support HSM but only via an integration project and a 4–6 week onboarding SLA. Alternative: customer-managed KMS + strict envelope encryption; if Cardea insists on HSM, we need a professional services fee to cover engineering effort.
- Discount: 40% across the board is high. Given commitment size and multi-year ARR, I recommend approving a one-time onboarding credit of 35% applied to year-1 consumption if they sign a 36-month contract with 30% upfront. Finance will need to confirm P&L impact.

Asking for: (1) legal confirmation that the audit window language can be constrained (scope + host-level protections), (2) finance sign-off on the suggested credit, and (3) exec approval for support-of-effort on HSM onboarding (PS fee acceptable).

Deal details: RDW-DEAL-2027-0819-CRD — quote and MAP attached.

Diego
Account Executive

- Discount: Deal desk can recommend an approval up to 35% onboarding credit for year 1 only, contingent on 30% upfront and a signed 36-month contract. Anything beyond requires leadership approval.

Team — reviewed Marissa's note and the proposed terms. Approve with the following firm conditions: 

1) Discount: Approve a 30% onboarding credit applied to invoices in year 1 only (not recurring); no additional discounts beyond that without VP approval.
2) Audit: Approve two remote audit windows per year, up to 2 business days each, with 10 business days notice. Audit scope must be pre-approved and documented in Schedule B; no live host shell or privileged host access.
3) KMS/HSM: We will commit to supporting HSM-backed keys provided Cardea pays the professional services onboarding fee (to be determined by Ben). Until HSM is fully onboarded we accept customer-managed KMS with documented exception.
4) Legal: Olga to prepare the Schedule B carveout and an indemnity clarification referencing regulator-driven audits. No contractual acceptance until legal approves final wording.

Please capture these conditions in the updated MAP and send to Cardea Legal once Olga has the language. Diego — please call Sanjay to confirm the counters and the requirement for 30% upfront payment.

Thanks — Laura
VP, Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
